summary: Andretti Acquisition Corp. II, a Cayman Islands SPAC trading on Nasdaq (POLE/POLEU/POLEW), filed an 8-K reporting non-redemption agreements with third-party holders ahead of its September 8, 2026 extraordinary general meeting, adjourned from August 28, 2026. The measures would extend the business-combination deadline from September 9, 2026 to September 9, 2027. Investors holding up to 6,248,959 public shares agreed not to redeem, receiving up to 1,562,240 Pubco shares if a deal closes by June 9, 2027, plus 520,747 more thereafter. Watch redemption levels, extension funding and deal timing.
